title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #8

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What did God tell the first man to do in the garden, according to Genesis 2:15? (1 mark)
   A. Leave it
   B. Sleep
   C. Sell it
   D. Work it and take care of it

2. Which choice is likely to bring a good result? (1 mark)
   A. Skipping class
   B. Doing homework before playing
   C. Telling a lie
   D. Copying from a friend

3. What is a parable? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of coin
   B. A prayer
   C. A song
   D. A story with a meaning that teaches a lesson

4. What did he ask Jesus for? (1 mark)
   A. A house
   B. Food
   C. Mercy, and to see
   D. Money

5. What does the word "annunciation" mean? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. A festival
   C. A journey
   D. An announcement

6. Which statement about forgiveness is true? (1 mark)
   A. Forgiving means telling lies
   B. Forgiving means the wrong was fine
   C. Forgiving takes courage
   D. Forgiving is a sign of weakness

7. Which number can a child in Kenya call for help, as given in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. 116
   B. 555
   C. 100
   D. 300

8. According to Acts 20:35, what is more blessed? (1 mark)
   A. To buy than to sell
   B. To give than to receive
   C. To sleep than to work
   D. To keep than to give

9. What does "Amen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you for food
   B. Let it be so
   C. Goodbye
   D. Hello

10. In which town did Mary live? (1 mark)
   A. Nain
   B. Jericho
   C. Nazareth
   D. Bethlehem

11. Which verse says that God so loved the world? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. John 3:16
   C. Luke 1:37
   D. Genesis 1:1

12. Which verses in Galatians speak of self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Galatians 5:22-25
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Acts 2:1
   D. Luke 1:37

13. In a family tree, where are the grandparents normally placed? (1 mark)
   A. At the bottom
   B. Outside the tree
   C. In the middle with the children
   D. At the top

14. Who forgave his brothers who had sold him? (1 mark)
   A. Balaam
   B. Joseph
   C. Samson
   D. Daniel

15. Which people did Balak want Balaam to curse? (1 mark)
   A. The Philistines
   B. The Romans
   C. The Israelites
   D. The Egyptians

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Give two reasons why the birth of Jesus is unique. (2 marks)

17. State four ways of looking after your body as God's special creation. (4 marks)

18. Describe three steps in planting and caring for a seed. (3 marks)

19. Describe three steps for saying no to temptation. (3 marks)

20. Explain why Christians should show the fruit of the Holy Spirit. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Work it and take care of it
   Genesis 2:15 says this.

2. B — Doing homework before playing
   Doing your work first helps you learn and stay out of trouble.

3. D — A story with a meaning that teaches a lesson
   Jesus used parables to teach.

4. C — Mercy, and to see
   He asked for mercy and said, "I want to see."

5. D — An announcement
   The annunciation is the announcement of Jesus' birth to Mary.

6. C — Forgiving takes courage
   Forgiveness is strong, not weak.

7. A — 116
   Childline Kenya can be reached free on 116.

8. B — To give than to receive
   Acts 20:35 quotes Jesus' words.

9. B — Let it be so
   Amen means so be it.

10. C — Nazareth
   Luke 1:26 says Gabriel came to Nazareth in Galilee.

11. B — John 3:16
   John 3:16 is the memory verse.

12. A — Galatians 5:22-25
   Galatians 5:22-25.

13. D — At the top
   A family tree shows the oldest generation at the top.

14. B — Joseph
   Joseph forgave his brothers in Egypt.

15. C — The Israelites
   Balak feared the Israelites camped on the plains of Moab.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Conceived by the Holy Spirit, announced by an angel, He is the Son of God and Saviour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Eat healthy food, keep clean, rest and exercise, avoid harmful things such as drugs, do not hurt yourself or others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Dig a hole, plant the seed and cover it, water it regularly, protect it, watch it grow.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, give a short reason, walk away, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: It pleases God, makes us like Jesus, and helps us to live well with others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.
